title: Instrumentation-driven model selection policy and regression suite for rerank
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Background: Our reranking endpoint sees variable latency and quality across locales. We currently pick model variants heuristically (by region and token budget) which has led to two incidents this quarter where a high-latency cross-encoder was routed into low-SLO traffic during peak. Objective: Build an instrumentation-driven policy that selects reranker variants (quantized/distilled/full) per-query, driven by fast signals (locale, query-length, historical latency, cache-hit probability). Complement the policy with a regression test suite that automatically verifies quality/latency when proposing model rollouts. Goals: 1) Reduce median and tail latency on low-tier routes by 15-25% without losing >1% NDCG on critical eval sets. 2) Enable safe canarying and automatic rollback for reranker upgrades with deterministic regression gates. 3) Provide telemetry and decision traces so SRE/PM can audit per-request model choice. Approach: - Instrument rerank request path to emit a lightweight decision token: {query-signals, chosen-variant, score-delta-estimate}. Implement this as a binary-serializable header to avoid payload inflation. - Implement a selection policy service (policy engine) that runs inside the inference plane with a tiny fast-fallback decision tree: prefer cached scores -> locale-prefers-distilled for short queries -> full cross-encoder for long queries or low-confidence prefix matches. Policy parameters are held in config and rollouts are controlled by Console. - Build an automated regression harness: per-commit canary runs against a standard multilingual eval set (English, Spanish, Japanese, German, Portuguese), measuring latency distributions, NDCG@10, and business metrics (CTR proxy from query logs). - Integrate with rollout system: preflight checks must pass (no >1% drop in NDCG and tail latency SLOs) before canary increases. - Add sampling to record full logits for failed gates to support offline model analysis. Out of scope: training new reranker architectures; this ticket focuses on orchestration, policy, and tests. Acceptance criteria: - Policy service implemented with config toggle and routed in one internal team for test traffic. - Instrumentation header emitted and consumed; traces available in Console (sampled). - Regression harness runs automatically for PRs on the rerank repo and publishes a clear pass/fail and diff report. - Canary rollout flow updated to require regression pass. - Documented runbook for SRE to interpret decision traces and perform emergency rollback. Risks & mitigations: - Risk: Increased CPU on inference plane for policy decisions -> mitigate by keeping policy deterministic and minimal (decision tree, <300ns median). - Risk: Instrumentation overhead increases request size -> mitigate by compact binary header and sampling. - Risk: Eval drift produces false positives -> mitigate by maintaining stable baseline eval data and introducing an "allow-list" for high-variance queries. Deliverables: - Policy engine prototype + unit tests - Instrumentation header spec + Console parser - Regression harness and multilingual eval suite - Canary policy config and rollout gating - Runbook and PagerDuty playbook
